title: Gameplan
note: Compacted from the Luigi Discord matchup notes.

do: Fireball / ZAir cancel Cross and Holy Water (Z-catch the water)
Axe is laggy (FAF 67): stay grounded, run in when he throws it close
Uppercut has 26f landing lag: punish it
Beat tether recovery with a long-lasting hitbox; ZAir his Up B
At ledge: delay the snap so Holy Water expires; neutral getup if he axes with no water
Easy to combo (no odd angles)
dont: Don't roll through Holy Fire at the ledge
Don't jump at ledge (Uair juggles); Ftilt is safe on shield and outranges everything
Fthrow at ledge kills: spot dodge, don't just shield
Cross travels far past him if you jump it; Axe goes through the stage, Utilt through platforms
Watch runoff Nair, Nair → Up B and Dair → Up B (DI dependent)

do: Mash out of Aerial Flame Choke at low %
Tech Dark Dive when recovering: easy hard punish
Shield Wizard's Foot (it slows on hit) and punish
dont: Wizard's Foot can cross up shield and may beat Fireball: watch spacing
Missing the Flame Choke tech = Dtilt / Ftilt / Jab / dash attack

do: ZAir edgeguards his recovery, especially Wolf Flash
Platform stages (Yoshi's, Smashville) help vs Blaster; Jab is faster (f2 vs f4)
Parry his landing Nair; punish Nair on shield OoS with Nair / Usmash / Up B (-9f)
Blaster: crouch with correct timing, or parry / short hop over (can't crawl, won't clank with Fireball)
Cyclone through Blaster works if predicted: don't overuse
dont: Fsmash is safe on shield
Fire Wolf hits from under stage: Dtilt ledge pressure is hard
Dsmash 2-frames and kills uncharged at ~70%; early kills: Fair → Bair, Nair → Dsmash at ledge
DI Dthrow and Nair down and away (Wolf Flash follow-ups ~30–80%; Nair 55–75%)
He baits with jump-in → DJ away

do: Cyclone out of Dthrow → Fair / Uair at low %
Landing Nair dodges Fire Arrows; Fireball clanks Fire Arrow and Boomerang, and sets off Bombs
Shielded Bombs that hit the ground don't explode
Trap him: small stages, few platforms
dont: RAR Bair (single hit leads to kill confirms)
Don't challenge Utilt with Nair: dodge, jump, or Cyclone
Reverse Up B doesn't snap ledge and can drag you into the hits
entries.stage: Best: Final Destination, Smashville · Avoid: Lylat, Pokémon Stadium 1/2, Kalos, Battlefield, Dream Land

do: Punish low balloons (Bair near stage, Fair away from it, Dair)
Punish helpless Up B landing (31f before she can shield)
Break Lloid Trap: running Dsmash, getup attack, drop-down Fair, jump Nair / Uair, Fsmash, Ftilt, Dtilt x2; you can run over it
Pivot Dsmash goes under rising Fair; Usmash beats landing Dair (unsafe on block)
dont: Normal getup doesn't work vs Lloid Trap; roll sets it off
Fireball doesn't break her pot
Watch the fishing rod's returning grabbox (bounces off shield, hitbox is on the lure)

do: Getup attack from ledge doesn't reach you: bait it into Fsmash kill
Plunger beats his Up B; ZAir him out of it
Fireball the cannonball back into the blunderbuss, then grab / Fsmash / Up B
Nair beats Crown as you land; belly armor breaks to a full Fsmash or Misfire
Big and easy to combo (Down B breaks out)
dont: He kills early: damage adds up fast
His spikes are easy to land: mix up recovery; his Up B outranges your Dair
Slow grab lets him rack up damage; punish belly armor Ftilt with Jab
Recovery mixups can drag you around

do: ZAir and Fireball destroy Lloid once it moves
Aerials beat slingshots; crawl so he uses landing slingshots (lag)
Demolish him if he uses Balloon Trip
dont: Bowling Ball beats your recovery
All his aerials gimp you and he goes deep offstage
F3 Nair evades your strings

do: Roller is unsafe on shield (OoS Nair); Fireball / ZAir stop it
Rapid jabs are unsafe; roll behind after 11 hits
Parry Bair, then Up B (needs parry SDI)
dont: Squid Jump's initial hitbox gimps you; landing hitbox is hard to punish
Bair is too safe on shield: punish it off a parry
Splat Bomb snipes your Green Missile recovery

do: ZAir destroys his recovery at any %
Keep him in the air; grab punishes Fsmash
Up B punishes shielded Side B
dont: Fsmash has insane super armor; KO Punch ignores shield
Huge shield damage: don't sit in shield
He rushes you down and catches you off guard with speed

do: Don't punish Nair on shield: shield, then punish what he does after
Shield his grab game (no true throw combos); Cyclone / Nair escape combos until he baits it
Recovery is linear: ZAir / Dtilt / Dair / Fireball; trade or win vs Firefox with an aerial
Crouch / crawl under Laser; camp with Fair, ZAir, Fireball
0-death: 20–30% Dthrow → Fair → landing Uair → Up B; 30–40% use ZAir instead of Uair
Dash attack on shield: Up B or grab
dont: He juggles with Uair strings: don't panic
Watch his double jump in neutral
He can't edgeguard well, but expect shine spikes

do: Fireball / ZAir approach slowly; counter is his only real mixup
Edgeguard with Dtilt / ZAir; his Up B above stage level is punished by smashes or Up B
At low % he has no tools: spam grab
Cyclone out of grab combos (few are true)
dont: Recovery is very hard (Neutral B, Counter, aerials, esp. Dair)
If a combo isn't true he mashes Down B for free %
Lucario camps with Neutral B / Side B; above 120% neutral gets very hard
Don't fear aura: finish stocks early

do: Fireball reflects Sun Ball and makes her approach; Fireball / Down B deflect Header
Landing Down B to the side beats her options (don't overuse)
Recovery is predictable: Bair through it, ZAir; stay above her offstage
Grab her out of dash attack; her aerials aren't safe on shield
Attack the front of her shield (she Bairs OoS when facing back)
dont: Nothing contests Utilt: land to the side
Slightly charged Sun Ball beats Fireball; don't challenge the ball with aerials
Side B snipes / spikes you offstage (huge hitbox); she edgeguards deep
Ledge trapping is risky: she stalls and hits you out of setups; mash out of her sweetspot Jab
Don't let her breathe (Deep Breathing buffs everything)

do: Arm Rotor is very unsafe: Up B every time; SDI out if behind him
He almost always Uairs at ledge: shield
Shield gyro deletes it; catch it with Dair / Fair rather than shielding repeatedly
Nair has startup: punish it; shield point-blank gyro → Up B
Recovery is vulnerable to Dair / ZAir (he can attack out of Up B)
dont: His Laser doesn't collide with anything
His recovery lets him edgeguard you relentlessly
Offstage gyro: catch it, throw it up before Up B to cover Dair

do: Light: he dies early
Punish spaced Bair with Up B OoS (poor spacing: Up B / Super Jump Punch)
ZAir can't be reflected by Oil Panic
dont: Don't go offstage: his recovery is insane
Uair is a free juggle (poor airspeed): airdodge carefully
Fire (f3) breaks combos and is a great OoS; Oil Panic makes Fireball a hazard
Disjoints make approaching hard

do: Punish Fsmash with grab / Up B; space him with Fireball
ZAir isn't affected by Tough Guy
Stay centre stage: if he short hops at the edge he's ready to Fair
Take an early stock lead: he kills very early
dont: Don't grab at the edge (spot dodge → Dsmash)
Tough Guy beats Fireball below mid %
At kill % don't walk into his smashes: wait and punish

do: Fsmash: punish once he loses his hurtbox (Up B / grab)
Shield Up B spam → grab / Up B; parry Up B above ledge → Up B / grab / Utilt / Fsmash / Dsmash
Fireball spaces him; punish a missed grab with Up B
Bait his recovery at the bottom of the stage (Up B has no intangibility)
dont: He racks up % with grab and Utilt combos
He kills early with gimps / jiggs (don't tech with Bair); trip → Fsmash: avoid Dtilt at high %

do: Bait Dash Attack → grab / Up B (few approach options outside Rainstorm)
Gimp him offstage with Fair / Dair / ZAir / Bair; coin gimp when he hangs past Plunger range
His true grabs are limited: Nair / Cyclone
Platform stages to approach his gun camping
Fireball + ZAir to wait out Arsene
dont: Mix up your recovery or Rainstorm gimps you
Side B isn't punishable at midrange
Arsene kills early at ledge: stay calm
He can Counter / Rebel's Guard Misfire for an easy kill

do: No projectiles: grab or combo starters
ZAir beats Up B, then Dair for a clean spike
Fireball / ZAir stop Falcon Kick
dont: He's faster than you: mind spacing
He goes low and far for spikes: use very low recoveries
His Up B often beats Dair: use ZAir → Dair

do: Side B is very unsafe on shield (shield drop → dash grab)
Wonderwing: Up B before Banjo moves, or from very low to dodge the 2f
dont: Wonderwing kills at very low % if 2-framed with no double jump
Uair juggles can't be Cycloned (Kazooie is disjointed)

do: Camp him: his approach is linear; ZAir and pivot grab do wonders
Fair → Nair stuff and 0-death are easy (Uair hitbox is odd)
Break combos with Nair / airdodge, mix it up (he baits Cyclone); DI away from ladder combos
Recover low (avoids FLUDD and Fair spikes), but save your jump
Read FLUDD and shield it; bair his Up B from the side
dont: Fireball clanks with Green Missile; Cape reverses it: don't recover low into Fireball
FLUDD ruins your jump / pushes you away: be careful with aggressive ledge options
All his aerials except Fair are safe on shield: punish the option after
Plunger loses to his Up B; Up B OoS is risky when FLUDD is charged
Fsmash has big range; he kills with Fsmash, Fair, Bair, ledge Bthrow, falling Uair → Fair

do: Up B OoS beats Leaf Shield (around him or thrown)
Uair clanks his Dair; ZAir blocks Metal Blade, Splat Bomb, pellets
SH Fireball → ZAir goes through multiple pellets
dont: Fsmash goes through all projectiles

do: Cyclone limits them to 1–3 hit strings and separates them
ZAir pokes both; Dash attack hits both; Fireball bounces their ice back
Separate with Uthrow or ZAir → Dtilt offstage, then take one off stage
On platforms ZAir them from above vs Blizzard
Core tools: dash attack, Cyclone, ZAir
dont: Little comboing from grab: nickel-and-dime them and look for gimps
Blizzard is spooky

do: Fireball destroys missiles and weak Charge Shots (punish her endlag with grab)
ZAir beats her tether; Fair hits her out of Screw Attack
Spot dodge her grab → Up B; spot dodge Jab 1 → pivot grab
Shield all multi-hits of her ledge Fair; bait Nair / Fair / tilts
0-death: aim for her foot and fade back the Uair slightly
dont: Charge Shot can't hit you on ledge as Samus, but Dark Samus's can
Don't throw careless Fireballs (full Charge Shot punishes)
Dthrow combos can't be Cycloned: DI / SDI instead
Your aerials are unsafe vs her f4 Screw Attack OoS; landing is awful: stay grounded
entries.stage: Best: Smashville (waveland the middle platform) · Avoid: Town & City, Kalos

do: Windbox Cyclone at the ledge works
Neutral B is blocked by everything but grab
dont: Fsmash covers all your moves except Cyclone, Fireball and Misfire

do: Fireball / ZAir space him; ZAir / Plunger gimp his recovery
Punish spaced-wrong Bair with Up B (average spacing: OoS Fair / Nair)
Dash attack and Side B on shield: Up B (Usmash also for dash attack)
Grab still cancels his armored Neutral B; combo him heavily
dont: Bair is safe on shield if spaced right
DI away from dash attack combos at low %
Utilt juggles you on platforms; Dtilt range and Side B pressure your shield

do: Fireball / ZAir keep her from approaching
Grab on landing; Cyclone is great (intangible, strong, damaging)
Punish Sing with grab; your aerials contest her
dont: Combos are shorter (floaty, light)
Her Nair edgeguards you easily

do: Dash attack / ZAir take out Luma; ZAir beats her recovery
Uthrow separates them (Dthrow combos weak)
dont: Uair juggles you: mix up landing
Luma can stop your recovery safely

do: ZAir / Fair keep him away (he absorbs Fireball); keep him in the air
Hit the start of PK Thunder to send him into freefall; ZAir / Fair gimp it; Cyclone windbox pushes him off (also after he hits himself with PK Thunder 2)
OoS Usmash / Up B punish bad landing aerials (Nair)
High %: bait, then Fsmash / Usmash / Up B
dont: PK Fire: DI away and up (no hitlag, so SDI doesn't work)
He edgeguards with PK Fire / PK Thunder: recover high, then low once he adapts
Bthrow kills fast; Uair + PK Thunder juggles
Yo-yo (lingering Usmash / Dsmash) 2-frames you: hold down on Up B then release to snap; SDI down and away

do: Bait the bomb out (it doesn't explode on impact), then strike; intercept his bomb recovery
ZAir beats all his projectiles and his recovery at ledge; Fireball pops bombs that aren't thrown
Recovery is mediocre: gimp his double jump (Fair / Bair after he drops the bomb)
dont: Fast faller: hard to combo
Better projectiles than Fireball: he camps, then strikes; heavy shield pressure
Boomerang gives him lots of %; Nair is safe on shield

do: You can crouchwalk under C4's explosion on the PS2 platforms
dont: Don't try it on Battlefield (needs a timed crouch)

do: Cyclone beats Spin Dash; ZAir can clank it → easy grab
Tilt your shield up vs Homing Attack (it shield pokes), then Fair / Bair
A Homing Attack out of range leaves him in huge endlag
ZAir him offstage (predict the directional airdodge)
dont: Don't stand still fireballing (Spin Dash is invincible early; he jumps over)
Spin Dash wiff punishes landing aerials: land away from him
Offstage: watch Fair and Spring (don't sit directly under the ledge; walls make it worse); Up B past ledge is a mixup
Fsmash is big, and dash-back Fsmash is quick

do: Fireball / ZAir space him and reflect Gordos; stay under platforms to dodge Gordos
Dtilt is unsafe on shield (aerials, Up B at high %); Up B OoS from FF Nair
Punish dash attack and Fsmash lag with grab / Up B; punish missed Down B with Up B / Fsmash / 0-death
ZAir 2-frames his recovery (not during Up B armor)
dont: He forces you defensive; Fsmash and dash attack do huge damage and shield damage
Multiple jumps and Up B armor: ZAir gimps often fail
Mix up recovery vs Gordo and save your jumps; poor airspeed gets you juggled
Down B is dangerous while hanging on ledge: bait the release; Gordo ledge traps

do: Missed grab → Up B; landing flip kick (extra lag) → Up B / Fsmash
ZAir / Fireball vs camping; OoS Usmash / Up B punish Dair, Side B, Usmash, Neutral B close
If grabbed, get to the ground asap (Fthrow tech chases)
dont: Her Uair juggles you: airdodge in time, Cyclone, or get to ledge
Dair trades stocks and beats Cyclone once intangibility ends: mix up recovery
She walls with ZAir / Side B / Neutral B: don't challenge ZAir, don't chase her flip kick
Don't charge Misfire offstage (Bair); Dair spike is techable only on stages with walls (not FD, BF, Smashville, Town)
Up throw kills at 160%

do: Laser at point blank is punishable with Fsmash
His Fair can clank with Up B offstage (coin gimp)
dont: His Fair and Nair poke your shield (even from a platform) and lead to combos / kills (Nair → Utilt → Uair / Bair)
Fair can't be beaten OoS unless fully blocked; he can stage spike or whiff the last hits to bait airdodge

do: Catch landings with pivot grab; run in when she short hops; grounded approaches (grab, Dtilt, Utilt, Fireball)
0-death is frame perfect: dair nair dair nair uair uair rUair bair; beware Counter
Her recovery is easy to 2-frame: ZAir → Dair (or ZAir / Dtilt); watch her teleport habits
When juggled retreat to ledge; Cyclone between her Nairs; DI / SDI out
dont: Don't hang out in the air (Nair); her Uair juggles you to early kills
Usmash at ledge goes high and catches airdodge: recover low; watch Uair under ledge at high %
Grabbed at high %: DI out vs Dthrow → Bair, DI in if hit
Explosive Flame: airdodge toward stage vs Side B
entries.stage: Ban triplat stages (platform juggles give her early kills)

do: Low mobility: combo and rush her down; lots of endlag to punish
ZAir hits her grapple recovery; crawl under a fully charged arrow
dont: Fair / Bair have range and kill power; she kills early
Most of her moves break shields; Side B has a huge hitbox (shield / parry from afar)

do: Tatsu is intangible but still loses to Utilt / Uair / Fair / Usmash OoS
dont: Don't shield Bair: Bair → Dsmash → true Up B breaks your shield

do: Tilt your shield up vs Fair / Bair / Nair (they shield poke)
Parry the last hit of Rising Tackle → Dtilt gimp at high %
Fireball / ZAir neutral shuts down his approach
Edgeguard: Burn Knuckle / Crack Shoot can be baited and punished
vs Dtilt spam at ledge: getup attack or drop ledge → Fair (don't roll)
dont: When Go! is active stay grounded (Power Geyser has a huge hitbox)
